mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, merchant_name_normalized, avg_amount, cycle_days, detected_count, category_id, is_excluded, status, next_expected_date, confirmed_at, relapse_detected_at FROM tbl_fixed_expense_candidate WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND is_excluded = 0 AND next_expected_date IS NOT NULL AND next_expected_date >= #{startDate} AND next_expected_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY next_expected_date, id
mapper.delete: DELETE reminder FROM tbl_fixed_expense_payment_reminder reminder INNER JOIN tbl_fixed_expense_candidate candidate ON candidate.id = reminder.fixed_expense_candidate_id WHERE candidate.user_id = #{userId}
